tldr: Bill Gates has expressed significant concerns about the future impact of artificial intelligence and called for "human reserved" jobs.
Iran and Oman have agreed on a temporary shipping corridor in the Strait of Hormuz, a development with geopolitical and economic significance.
More than 40,000 additional deaths in England between 1988 and 2025 were linked to extreme heat, according to the Office for National Statistics.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both closed higher, influenced by a decrease in oil prices partly due to hopes for a deal on a temporary shipping corridor in the Strait of Hormuz. Traders were also awaiting upcoming inflation data and Nvidia earnings.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield declined, which could be attributed to expectations surrounding forthcoming inflation data and Nvidia earnings. Developments hinting at a potential easing of oil transit issues in the Strait of Hormuz may have also contributed to reduced inflation concerns.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, decreased as both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite recorded gains, indicating a reduction in market uncertainty.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate saw a slight decrease in its weekly survey, consistent with the 10-year Treasury yield's recent decline. Articles suggest this decline in yields is linked to expectations regarding inflation data and developments in the Strait of Hormuz.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations would provide guidance on employer contributions to Trump accounts and related nondiscrimination rules.
policy_week.effect: Your employer's contributions to your Trump account would be subject to new guidance.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Bill Gates has expressed deep concerns regarding the future impact of artificial intelligence, suggesting the need for "human reserved" jobs in certain sectors to prevent AI from displacing them and highlighting governmental unpreparedness for AI's societal effects.
IBM has introduced its new Granite 4.2 models, focusing on agentic capabilities and predictable enterprise deployment, joining the growing interest in local Large Language Models.

world.summary: Iran and Oman have reached an agreement for a temporary shipping corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global waterway.
China has issued an advisory for its citizens to depart Eswatini, the only African nation maintaining diplomatic ties with Taiwan, citing "security risks."

Data from the Office for National Statistics indicates that over 40,000 additional deaths occurred on the hottest days in England between 1988 and 2025 than would typically be expected, highlighting the rising toll of the climate crisis.
Canada plans to impose retaliatory tariffs on nearly $20 billion worth of U.S. goods, mirroring previous U.S. actions and intensifying a trade dispute between the two nations.

us.summary: The president of the International Criminal Court, who faced U.S. sanctions, has requested Japan's government assist in de-escalating tensions with the United States.
The Trump administration has implemented new sanctions on Iran, aiming to increase financial pressure in the context of the six-month conflict.
A border crossing in Arizona has reopened to allow cattle from Mexico into the U.S. for the first time in over a year, despite ongoing concerns about a parasite on the Mexican side.

science.summary: HPV home-testing kits are now available in England, with nearly four million women expected to receive invitations to order a free kit for self-testing.

A new study revealed that at least 25% of former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 were found to have Chronic Traumatic Encephalopathy (CTE), shedding light on the prevalence of the brain disease.
